attributes.name: Corruption Demon
attributes.powers:
The Corruption Demon is immune to the Electricity, Mental, and Poison traits.

Before you act, succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 14 check or summon and build the location Middle of Nowhere and move there.

If undefeated, display this card next to your deck. While displayed, your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma dice are each d4. At the start of your turn, roll 1d4; you may bury that number of cards to banish this card.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Corruption Demon, change the last sentence to "At the start of your turn, roll 1d4; you may bury that number of cards to banish this card."
corrections.issue: The Corruption Demon is displayed next to my deck. Do I have to decide whether or not I'm burying cards before I roll to find out how many need to be buried?
